# AIS-HUM-03

**Is the design's class under the AI regulations that apply to it recorded, with the impact assessment it requires?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [AI solution lens](ai-solution.md) 0.4.0 |
| Area | HUM: People and obligations |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool checks presence; a reviewer judges |
| Reads | `drivers.obligations`, `drivers.obligations.role`, `evidence.type` |

## Rule

drivers.obligations has an entry whose source names an AI instrument, with the organisation's role under it and whether a substantial modification makes it the provider; evidence has an ai-impact-assessment unless the obligation records why none is needed. A reviewer checks the duties that role brings, such as a deployer's fundamental rights impact assessment under the EU AI Act Article 27 and AI literacy under Article 4.

## Sources

- Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, the AI Act, as amended by the Digital Omnibus (`eu-aiact`)
- ISO/IEC 42005:2025, AI system impact assessment (`iso42005`)
- ISO/IEC 42001:2023, AI management system (`iso42001`)

Defined in [`standards/assessment/lenses/ai-solution.yaml`](../../standards/assessment/lenses/ai-solution.yaml). How results, findings and outcomes work: the [Architecture Assessment Standard](../../standards/assessment/standard-architecture-assessment.md).
